subject: english
question:
**Select the word which means the same as the group of words given.**

one who talks to oneself
solution:
The correct answer is **Soliloquist**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Soliloquist **(एकालापी)**: **to utter a soliloquy; talk to oneself.

 
 
• **Example: **He has become a **soliloquist **after being lonely for many years.
 
 
 
• Thus, the word which means the same as the group of words given is given in **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ventriloquist **(पेटभाषी)**: **someone who entertains people by speaking without moving their lips, to make it seem as if the voice is coming from somewhere else.

 
 
• **Example**: The ventriloquist amazed the crowd by having a conversation with her puppet without moving her lips.
 
 
 
• **Colloquist (**बातचीत करनेवाला**): **One who participates in a conversation, especially a formal one.
 
• **Somniloquist **(स्वप्नभाषी)**: **one who talks in his sleep.
